messages:
Anya: Quick heads-up — lacerta9b intake is blocked on two things for the catalog launch: (1) license approval (the SPDX/terms look nonstandard) and (2) perf profile mismatch vs our expected baseline. This is gating the model-card publish and the Monday launch milestone. Can legal, perf, and runtime owners weigh in?

Sam: I can take perf probe ownership. Will run a 1k prompt sweep and basic latency/throughput matrices today. Which prompt set should I use?

Anya: Use the /datasets/openmodels/latency-tier-A set (internal link: https://redwood.internal/datasets/latency-tier-A). Include streaming latency and 8k vs 4k context runs. Also include the tokenization edge cases from the manifest tests.

Marta: I need the license file and the model's provenance doc. The header says "Community Use v0.9" which isn't approved for commercial distribution yet — do we have upstream permission?

Anya: License file is attached in the intake page, but it's the draft text (see snippet below). If legal needs us to request additional clarifications from upstream, ping me and I’ll loop in the curator.

infra-bot: Intake created: https://redwood.internal/models/lacerta9b — manifest: ```name: lacerta9b
source: weights://s3/openmodels/lacerta9b/v1
license: COMMUNITY-0.9-draft
quantization: q4_0
expected_context: 4096```

Leo: FYI the ingestion job failed in staging with a kv-cache allocation error, looks like the model uses a different hidden-size -> kv-shape mapping. Pasted log: `RuntimeError: KV cache size mismatch: expected 512, got 768`

eng-runtime: thanks for the flag @Leo — can you attach the staging manifest? I’ll triage whether kernel mapping or our ingest converter is wrong.

Leo: Attached staging manifest and the converter logs. Quick patch (probable) is to align the kv reshape in the conversion step — filing PR now.

Sam: Re perf: initial sweep (500 prompts, 4k context) shows 12% slower token pacing vs our baseline model in the same family. 4-bit quant gives +18% memory saving but latency delta is still +8%. I'll run the 8k sweep next.

Marta: I started a legal review thread. If the upstream can sign a non-commercial exception that won't work for customers. We need a clear footprint on downstream rights. I can get a draft request by end of day tomorrow.

Anya: Action items: (1) @Sam — finish 8k sweep and attach perf CSV by EOD. (2) @Leo — open PR for ingest converter fix and link CI. (3) @Marta — confirm license review ETA and whether we need upstream legal ping. (4) @eng-runtime — triage kv-cache mapping once PR lands. If all green, we can flip catalog gating to "ready for publish" and schedule canary.

Sam: Will post CSV + brief summary by 1800 PT.

Leo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/482 — CI running, dropped kv reshape patch.

Marta: I can do the license draft request and send to the curator by tomorrow 10:00 PT. If they reply with a clear commercial grant, we’re good; if not, we'll need legal-approved mitigation language for the model card.

Anya: Great — moving to owners: perf: Sam, legal: Marta, ingest/runtime: Leo + eng-runtime. Can everyone confirm?

Sam: Confirmed. :white_check_mark:

Marta: Confirmed. Will update legal status in the intake doc thread. :spiral_note_pad:

eng-runtime: Confirmed — we’ll watch the PR and smoke test staging after merge.

Anya: Thanks all. Reopening only if blocker remains after PR + perf sweep. I’ll update the release board and remove the gating flag once legal signs off. :thumbsup:
